messages.subject: propto issue with point estimate
parts:
Just an FYI, the point_estimate functionality is broken due to the
issue with propto (i.e., the fact that log_prob and grad_log_prob will
give different numerical values). I don't have time to fix it now,
but given that it's currently not working, this should be clearly
labeled. I'll try to get a fix in tomorrow.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] propto issue with point estimate
parts: On 4/10/13 12:32 AM, Marcus Brubaker wrote:> Just an FYI, the point_estimate functionality is broken due to the

> issue with propto (i.e., the fact that log_prob and grad_log_prob will
> give different numerical values). I don't have time to fix it now,
> but given that it's currently not working, this should be clearly
> labeled. I'll try to get a fix in tomorrow.

Thanks for reminding me. I'd meant to fix this
before!

I just reverted the generated code so that the
results should be the same again. To use the double-only
version of log_prob(), you'll need to explicitly specify
the templates. The API will probably need to change in
the future so this is clearer.

Now log_prob calls log_prob_grad as before.
On the downside, each operation is slower and takes more
memory. On the upside, it doesn't do any of the propto
calcs and matches the log_prob_grad result. Until we sort
out the API more clearly, we should at least have this
consistency.

We need unit tests and doc for optimization.

- Bob
